design.key_source: OPENAI_API_KEY environment only; never saved by adapter
design.source_allowlist: Explicit canonical document ID to current raw SHA256 mapping required before embedding any corpus chunk
design.cache_key: SHA256 of model, dimensions, and exact unnormalized input SHA256
design.cache_payload: Vectors and hashes only; original source text is not stored in the embedding cache
design.local_index_payload: Full chunks stored in manifest.json for source hydration; Chroma stores explicit vectors and flat source references
design.token_budget: Conservative UTF8 byte upper bound, explicitly labeled rather than reported as actual tokenizer count
design.session_budget: Unique uncached inputs are preflighted before first call; attempted calls consume budget even on failure; SDK retries disabled
design.pricing: No monetary estimate or fabricated fixed API prices; token upper-bound cap controls usage
design.scope: Aliases resolve to canonical IDs before query embedding; unknown IDs fail, explicit empty scope returns no results and makes no API request
design.collection_reuse: Corpus/source/model/dimensions mismatch fails rather than reusing or deleting the collection
design.scores: Negative cosine distance, not confidence or correctness probability
design.local_baseline: Independent BM25/character-TFIDF/RRF/MMR defaults do not depend on this module

limits: No live SDK/API/Chroma integration was executed because packages and an API key were unavailable
Only verified text-embedding-3-small and text-embedding-3-large model names are accepted
The conservative byte bound may reject inputs that a model tokenizer would accept; rechunk or later add a verified tokenizer instead of treating bytes as exact tokens
Full corpus may exceed the default session upper-bound budget and will stop before requests; review and explicitly set a larger cap before opting in
Source SHA allowlisting checks the approved source version; exact source-span recovery is enforced by the separate chunk quality validation, not by retrieving raw files inside this adapter
manifest.json and local Chroma data contain source-derived data and remain in the selected local index directory
stored_vector_integrity_limitation: Chroma load checks collection metadata and count; alteration of stored vector values under unchanged IDs/count is not exhaustively detected. Local embedding cache input/value integrity is separately checked.
